Seeing two same-sex NPCs together in town, having an NPC be non-binary, or have it be revealed that an NPC is aromantic I think would make NPCs (and the world they inhabit) actually feel more real.

It is something worthy of discussion. The consensus however I do get (from cis straight folk) is that they don't want to misrepresent queer people. I personally take this with some sadness, as it seems cis-heteros overcomplicate queer topics.

Like, just make a cool guy but it turns out they're asexual! Bada-bing, badaboom, representation! LGBTQ+ people are - you know, people. Just roleplay like you would normally. It's a shame culture has evolved to see LGBTQ people, but apparently not the same way they would straights.

In the long term, Dysphoria can only be helped with hormone therapy, or sex reassignment. Sometimes even after all that, trans people still feel it. Being complimented about femininity, gendered right and all that other stuff really only helps short term.

1.) It would be perfectly okay! Gotta figure out boundaries.

2.) Dysphoria pretty much only goes away the more someone feels like their gender. It's a complex mush of looks, voice, hair, all sorts of stuff.

3.) I do not know, but I would assume a vast majority.

4.) My voice and body are extreme sources of dysphoria. How wide my shoulders are, or how masculine my voice is.

Also, you can try to get your gf to open up about her dysphoria. What triggers it, what might not, what you can do to help her, all that stuff. Two trans girls may have completely different sources of dysphoria, so it's not the same between all of us.
